hook: Katamaran: an open-source Docker and Linux runtime
hookText: Katamaran: an open-source Docker and Linux runtime

beats.say: Katamaran runs Docker containers and LXC Linux machines inside one lightweight VM on Apple silicon, pairing a patched libkrun/Hypervisor.framework monitor with a native Swift app; its author says it matches or beats OrbStack.
It includes the kat CLI, automatic port forwarding and Rosetta support, needs an M1 or later Mac on macOS 15+, and is AGPL-3.0.
Networking runs in-process with gvproxy, and unused guest memory returns to macOS in 64 KiB blocks. katamaran requires an Apple silicon Mac running macOS 15 or later.
